newsitem.title: UK: Sri Lanka plans $50 million bond - Citibank.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka plans $50 million bond - Citibank.

text.p: Sri Lanka is preparing to borrow $50 million from the international capital markets, Citibank International said in a statement on Tuesday.

The deal will be a floating-rate note (FRN) and will be sold to European and Asian investors. Roadshows will be held in Hong Kong, London and Bahrain, and the transaction was expected to be completed by the end of March, the statement said.
Citibank International and ING Barings will be joint lead managers of the FRN, Sri Lanka's first international bond since 1982, the statement said.
The deal's proceeds would be used to finance infrastructure developments in Sri Lanka, it said.
